newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - March 17.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - March 17.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Riyadh governor Prince Salman gets Bosnia's top award.
- Saudi Arabia to deport another 21 Indian child beggars.
- Turkey is sending 61,183 pilgrims to this year's annual pilgrimage to Islam's holiest shrines in Saudi Arabia.
- Algeria seeks more economic links with Saudi Arabia.
- Pilgrim quota system to stay, information minister says.
- King Fahd receives message from Iranian president.
- Saudi Consolidated Electric Company - Central starts on Monday to pay 316 million riyal dividend to shareholders.
- Saudi investors urged to invest in tourism in Morocco.
- Around 107,000 jobs are expected to be available in the industrial city of Jubail during the next 13 years.
